Trump hosts crypto executives at White House, signals possible government BTC accumulation and pushes Clarity Act –
Link
Trump met with executives from Coinbase, Ripple, Robinhood, Kraken, Gemini, and Chainlink. He said the administration has “completely ended the war on crypto” and said the government has discussed accumulating a “significant amount” of Bitcoin, though no funding source or timeline was given. He also urged Congress to pass a “fair version” of the Clarity Act.
Matters because: The comments add policy tailwinds for crypto, but the BTC-reserve idea is still only sentiment support without concrete details.
